summary: Feature request to add a preloadModules property to BundlerOptions in the workflow bundler, allowing users to specify modules that should be preloaded during VM initialization to reduce per-workflow memory usage and initialization time.
userImpact: Users will experience reduced per-workflow memory consumption and faster workflow initialization when using the workflow bundler with preloaded modules.
proposedFix: Add a `preloadModules` property to `BundlerOptions`. Those modules should be preloaded during early initialization of the reuse v8 context workflow vm executor.
keyQuote: This will significantly reduce the per-workflow memory footprint, as well as per-workflow initialization time.
